dataset.source: UCI ML Repository dataset 67, Molecular Biology (Promoter Gene Sequences), E. coli

bug87: sequence_pipeline_demo lesioned the training sequences re-encoded one-hot regardless of encoding; docstring said kmer was default while code used onehot. Now lesions held-out sequences with the training encoding; docstring matches code.
bug88: rsa and lesion_study defaulted to n_in=6 and crashed (matmul dim mismatch 200 vs 6) on every sequence-trained model; defaults now use the model input width; rsa accepts real stimuli X.
negatives: one-hot position-specific encoding memorises 57-nt promoters (holdout 0.727, CV10 above) - kmer generalises better but default kept as documented onehot; no refit of defaults
continual_update is an L2 anchor to previous weights (no Fisher information) despite ewc naming
classic literature accuracies on this dataset were not re-verified here
